sentences.text:
OFFICE NO. NOTE 05. 08.05.2025 Dr.VJP, J  I.A.No.1 of 2025  The instant petition under Section 389(1)
 of Cr.P.C., has been filed by the  Petitioner/Accused seeking to release him on  bail by suspending the sentence imposed  against him, pending disposal of the criminal  appeal.

The Petitioner is convicted and  sentenced to undergo Rigorous imprisonment  for 20 (Twenty) Years and shall pay fine of  Rs.5,000/- and in default of payment of fine  amount, the accused shall undergo simple  imprisonment for a period of one month for the  offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) of  IPC and under Section 5(j)(ii)(l) r/w Section 6 of  POCSO Act, 2012 and further the accused is  sentenced to undergo imprisonment for a period  of one year and shall pay fine of Rs.1,000/- and  in default of payment of fine amount, to under  Simple Imprisonment for a period of One month  for the offence punishable under Sections 417  of IPC.
 Heard Sri G.V.Narayana Reddy, learned  counsel for the Petitioner and Ms.K.Priyanka  Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor  for Respondent.
Learned counsel for the Petitioner would submit that, the Petitioner has been in jail post conviction.
It is submitted that they have good grounds to succeed in the appeal and the appeal may take considerable time for disposal.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor  SL. DATE ORDER OFFICE NO.
NOTE vehemently opposed the petition and would submit that there are no tenable grounds to suspend the sentence of imprisonment in view of the nature of the offence committed by the Petitioner.
